cv.name: Siobhán McNamara
cv.headline: Chief Procurement Officer | MedTech | Strategic Sourcing & Supplier Risk
cv.summary: Procurement leader with over twenty years in Galway's medical device sector, from buyer to CPO of a multi-site group. I run category strategy, supplier risk and procurement transformation, and sit on the group leadership team.

experience.title: Chief Procurement Officer
bullets: Lead a 35-person procurement function across four plants in Ireland and Costa Rica with €410M addressable spend
Launched a dual-sourcing programme for critical resins and electronics after the 2021 shortages
Delivered €18M in savings over three years while holding supplier quality metrics
Introduced a supplier sustainability scorecard aligned to CSRD reporting
Member of the group executive leadership team

experience.title: Head of Procurement
bullets: Built the strategic sourcing team and moved indirect spend onto a source-to-pay platform
Negotiated multi-year agreements with titanium and contract sterilisation suppliers

experience.title: Senior Sourcing Manager
bullets: Category lead for machined components and packaging

experience.title: Buyer
bullets: Purchasing of raw materials and tooling for a contract manufacturer

certifications: MCIPS – Chartered Institute of Procurement & Supply
